newsitem.title: BELGIUM: VOLVO SETS 8.0 BLN BFR CP PROGRAMME.
newsitem.headline: VOLVO SETS 8.0 BLN BFR CP PROGRAMME.

text.p: Volvo Group Finance Europe BV has set up a commercial paper programme for a maximum of eight billion Belgian francs or its equivalent in any other freely available foreign currency, under the guarantee of AB Volvo, arranging bank Generale Bank said on Monday.
It said in a statement that the paper would be issued in dematerialised form with maturities of at least 15 days.
This issue is due to replace an existing programme set up in 1991 in which the issued notes have the form of promissory notes.
Volvo Group Finance Europe BV is a fully-owned subsidiary of Volvo Group Finance Sweden AB, itself a fully-owned subsidiary of AB Volvo.
It is active on the international money and capital markets and provides Volvo subsidiaries, mainly in Europe, with short- and long-term funding, Generale Bank said.
"The present programme has been set up in the context of that activity," the statement said.
Generale Bank will also act as dealer, together with Banque Bruxelles Lambert (BBL) and Kredietbank , and as domiciliary agent for the issuer.
